basic_info.description: Stylish, spacious, and so elegantly home-like, this two-level townhouse corner unit has direct gated entry from the courtyard and amazing outdoor space including a private patio and two view roof decks. The spacious main level has hardwood floors and wonderful natural light from floor to ceiling patio doors, living room with fireplace, dining room area, a remodeled eat-in kitchen with granite counter tops, stainless appliances, home office area, and a pass-through to the living room, and a powder room. The upper level has three bedrooms including a luxurious primary bedroom suite with walk-in closet and exquisite en suite bath. Two additional large bedrooms share a second full bath. Private outdoor spaces include patios and a roof deck with stunning, iconic views. One car parking and laundry room in-unit. Incredible location on the Embarcadero waterfront, so close to the Ferry Building and its farmers market, FiDi, Jackson Square, Walton Square Park, destination dining spots.
